definitions.explanation: A mathematical operation that finds the rate of change of a function; a core concept in calculus.

examples.japanese: この{関数|かんすう}を{微分|びぶん}する。
{微分|びぶん}{積分|せきぶん}は{高校|こうこう}で{習|なら}う。
examples.english: Differential and integral calculus is taught in high school.

examples.japanese: {微分|びぶん}{方程式|ほうていしき}を{解|と}くのは{難|むずか}しい。

notes:
{微分|びぶん} is the mathematical operation of differentiation — finding the rate of change of a function. Compound of {微|び} (minute/slight) + {分|ぶん} (division).

USAGE:
Used as a する verb: {微分|びぶん}する (to differentiate).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {微分|びぶん}する: to differentiate
- {微分|びぶん}{積分|せきぶん}: differential and integral calculus (often paired together)
- {微分|びぶん}{方程式|ほうていしき}: differential equation
- {偏|へん}{微分|びぶん}: partial differentiation
- {微分|びぶん}{係数|けいすう}: derivative (coefficient)

RELATED TERMS:
- {積分|せきぶん}: integration (the inverse operation)
- {導関数|どうかんすう}: derivative function
- {関数|かんすう}: function

EDUCATION:
In Japan, {微分|びぶん}{積分|せきぶん} (calculus) is typically introduced in the third year of {高校|こうこう} (high school) as part of the mathematics curriculum.
